list_member_invalid.string: One or more selected members are not contacts in this address book.
list_member_invalid.context: Inline error when a distribution list member is invalid.

addressbook_duplicate.string: An address book with this name already exists.
addressbook_duplicate.context: Toast when address book creation conflicts.

contact_duplicate.string: A contact with this identifier already exists.

list_duplicate.string: A distribution list with this name already exists.

access_denied.string: You do not have permission to modify this address book.
access_denied.context: Toast when write access is denied.

read_only.context: Toast when mutating a read-only address book.

file_too_large.string: The photo exceeds the maximum allowed size (2 MB).
file_too_large.context: Inline error when contact photo upload is too large.

file_type_not_allowed.string: This file type is not allowed for contact photos.
file_type_not_allowed.context: Inline error when contact photo type is not allowed.

generic.string: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
generic.context: Fallback error message for contact API errors.
